name: L1
prompt: We are designing a pedal steel guitar plugin UI (Northern Valley Audio). Image 1 is our current approved STYLE (materials, colours, fonts, header bar, footer bar). Image 2 is a physically correct 3D render showing the correct perspective and the correct instrument anatomy (keyhead with tuning keys at LEFT end, changer at RIGHT end, ten strings, black fretboard, chrome bar, pickup near the changer). Keep the header bar (logo, amber LED preset display, BROWSE, SAVE, OUTPUT meter, TRIM, PLAY/MOTION/EFFECTS tabs) and the footer bar (MODE, VOLUME PEDAL slider, 72%, MIDI LEARN) exactly like image 1. EXPERIMENT ONLY WITH THE CENTER AREA between header and footer: its layout, sizing and arrangement, as described below. It must still contain: the instrument; six knobs TONE 65 %, PICK 40 % (VOICE), GLIDE 145 ms, SWELL 35 % (FEEL), ECHO 18 %, REVERB 28 % (SPACE) with big readable value readouts; foot pedals A, B, C (A and B lit amber) and knee levers LKL, LKR as real chrome-and-rubber hardware. PERSPECTIVE RULE (critical): ONE camera for the whole image. Every 3D object is seen from the same single viewpoint; flat UI panels are perfectly front-on; never mix a top view and a front view on the same object; the instrument must be anatomically correct and symmetric in perspective. LEGIBILITY: all labels bold, large, high contrast, readable at half size. Ultra-realistic premium render, 1600x1000. Layout: instrument is a huge hero filling the center width, seen from above at about 50 degrees so the strings and fretboard read big; directly below it ONE slim black control strip holds the six knobs in a single row on the left two-thirds and compact pedals A B C plus levers LKL LKR on the right third. Generate 2 images.
